notes.title: ZARANDARA Part 2: "True ROGUE" preview *Free major update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39418505/f1fd48da5eacd3b541a792c4adae74a51efb9046.jpg[/img]
A year has passed since the end of the deadly battle against the Black Carnage.
Zarandala and Vrinda are visited by Zarandala's adoptive father, Varuna Valsala, and his former subordinate, Ravana Ceylon, and the Asura Priest Warriors. .....!
Judgment to be brought upon them both!
And the Asuras and the Vedas, who are no longer supposed to fight, are about to fight again: .....!
And the "true ROGUE" that appears!
[strike]※The scenario is still in the planning stage, except for the ending, so things may change.[/strike]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39418505/69efa97e4fc57e29ee001b560249dcd67e18efdb.jpg[/img]

So I don't know when it will be, but I'll show you a glimpse of what the update will be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39418505/05df24f9135afc44513bba395a2e76428b60509c.jpg[/img]

High difficulty and speedy (maybe less than 7 dungeon levels) development!
Finally, it is implemented. The score system!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39418505/a5ffff50fb427814721fe797b843e9672f95ee98.jpg[/img]

If I think it's going to be too long, I may split it into three serialized updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39418505/2659c2c621edb2f112e68af0fddea6c6b3c4b2b3.jpg[/img]


Omake: Rough image of the final boss battle

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39418505/b00fdaf5e320f74af34870c281126de73a9f2a3c.jpg[/img]
